title: Copilot Medium 02 - Prompt Files
description: Prompt files para workflows repetibles: tests, review, refactor y PR.
author: AI Practice Hub

content.title: Prompt files
content.subtitle: No repitas el mismo ritual de tests, review y PR cada dia.

subtitles.text: Un prompt file es una herramienta invocable, no una instruccion global.

content.code:
---
description: "Generate focused tests"
mode: "agent"
tools: ["read", "search", "edit", "execute"]
---

Find the smallest behavior that needs test coverage.

Before editing:
- Identify existing test conventions.
- Name the file where tests should live.
- State the missing behavior.

Then add focused tests and run the relevant test command.

subtitles.text: El frontmatter define descripcion, modo y herramientas.
Esto convierte buenas practicas en atajos de equipo.
Invocable, acotado y verificable. Asi se disena un prompt file.
